blocks.html:
Mustang Car Wrap

Vinyl Wrap Toronto has seen an increase in the number of customers asking for decals and racing stripes recently. Especially among the muscle car owners, like Mustangs and Camaros. This Mustang was a beautiful blue when it arrived. The addition of the White Stripes with a little red detail on the Mustang car wrap makes the vehicle now even more special to the owner. Attention to detail is why customers choose Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

We have seen a few muscle cars with stripes either bought as kits or factory done. The main reason this customer came to Vinyl Wrap Toronto was the fact he did not want the stripes to end up skewed or crooked.
This happens occasionally when people buy stripe kits online and apply the stripes themselves. There is definitely an art to getting the stripes straight and centred. The stripes start from the front bumper and flow all the way to the back bumper.

The customer and our installation crew decided not to wrap the stripes on the spoiler. This just looks better and does not make the stripes over the top. Also wrapping the spoiler can make the white stripes look unbalanced or weird on the Mustang due to the angles of the spoiler.

View our Mustang car wrap job with a decal with Coyote Heads.

Speak to our installation team about your recreational or equipment wraps at 416-746-1381. Vinyl Wrap Toronto also does small decals, logos, and Fleet Wraps.

Or Visit our garage with your vehicle and ideas to see samples of the vinyl we use at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit #1, Etobicoke, M9W 1B4.
If you are looking for any HealthSafetyBoards or Covid-19 posters, Signs, or Floor Graphics, Visit HealthSafetyBoard.com
For Facemasks Visit WorkwearToronto.com our Workwear and Apparel Shop.

Vinyl Wrap is in the process of wrapping a Mustang Saleen. Like us on Facebook, Follow us on Instagram, Heart us on Twitter and add a Comment on Pinterest, to see more of our wraps. Check out more car decals here.
